svg.aria-label: Vertical east–west section through the cathedral: voxels inside and outside, below them the distance field
svg.text: A section through the cathedral and its south tower, from west to east
Top: the voxels of the 1 m grid. Bottom: the distance to the nearest wall or roof, limited to ±5 m.
Red: in a building · White: air · grey lines every 10 m
West edge E 726 367 m East edge E 726 667 m N 5 434 231.5 m · height up to 115 m above the lowest ground
